feesNotes.label: Good to know
feesNotes.title: How fees work
items: First class is a free trial — no payment until you decide to continue.
Sibling discount: 10% off the second child's fees.
Fees are paid monthly by transfer or DuitNow; no registration fee, no long contract.
Missed classes can be replaced at the other branch in the same week.

why.label: Why parents choose us
why.title: Every book marked, every parent told.
why.text: Big centres put thirty students in a room and hope. We cap classes at eight, so the teacher knows exactly where each child is stuck.
why.imageAlt: Student writing neatly in an exercise book

points.title: Maximum 8 per class
points.text: Small enough that no one hides at the back.

points.title: Monthly progress note
points.text: A short WhatsApp to parents after every monthly test — what improved, what to watch.

points.title: Same teachers, both branches
points.text: Cheras and Sungai Long share one team, so replacements are easy.

points.title: Three languages
points.text: Classes in English, Bahasa Malaysia or Chinese, matched to the school.

items.quote: My son went from a D to a B in Add Maths in one term. The monthly note tells me more than his school does.
Eight students in the class. The teacher actually knows my daughter's name and her weak topics.
We moved from Sg Long to Cheras and kept the same teacher. That mattered.
